item.title: Products
item.description: Machine learning application for the non-invasive prediction of euploidy in human embryos based on morphokinetic data. Computer program registration granted by INPI in 2026.

item.title: INPI grants software registration for Euploidy Prediction with Machine Learning
item.description: The registration formalizes the legal protection of the software that applies Machine Learning to embryonic euploidy prediction based on morphokinetic data.

item.title: Publications
item.description: Computer program registration granted by INPI under process BR512026003650-0, for a system that uses machine learning and morphokinetic data for the non-invasive prediction of embryonic euploidy, supporting clinical decision-making in assisted reproduction. Rights holder: Fundação Universidade de Brasília (UnB).
